source.author: CoinCoin
source.note: Wave-1 row 3 named the Ultimate Animated Animals wolf (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked). The reachable Quaternius wolf (Animal Pack Vol.2, OpenGameArt, CC0) has only Idle and Walking; this CC-BY wolf has a stronger silhouette and seven clips. Its clips are all named "Baked frames…" and were identified by eye. Two are left out with ingest.keepActions: a howl (2.7 s) and a crouch-and-pounce attack (1.9 s), whose long brush tail passes 16 and 24 cm through the ground while the feet stay planted, so lifting them would float the whole wolf.
